title: User Documentation — Operator Manual, Getting Started, and API Reference
goal: Give every new operator everything they need to go from zero to completed first scan without reading internal governance docs or asking for help.
scope: Four documentation deliverables: (1) OPERATOR MANUAL (docs/manual/operator-manual.md): A complete end-user manual covering: what AegisPT is and what it does (1 page), installation (link to install docs), first scan walkthrough (wizard → mission control → findings → report), understanding findings (severity, evidence, methodology), remediation workflow, report types and when to use each, Settings configuration, AI features how-to (connect ChatGPT, enable features), troubleshooting common problems (no findings on LAN → wrong profile, settings loading → server issue, etc.). Written for a security consultant, not a developer. No internal governance language. (2) GETTING STARTED GUIDE (docs/manual/getting-started.md): A 5-minute guide: install → connect → first scan → first report. The single document a new operator reads before anything else. (3) API REFERENCE: Enable FastAPI's built-in OpenAPI/Swagger documentation at /api/docs (currently disabled or not linked). Every endpoint documented with: description, request/response examples, error codes. Available at http://localhost:8000/api/docs when the server runs. (4) UPDATE README.md: The current README describes the first operational slice from a year ago. Update to reflect the current product state, capabilities, and links to the new documentation.
generation_reason: There is no user-facing documentation. The 70+ docs in docs/ are all internal governance docs for Codex. A new operator finds a README describing the system as it was a year ago, with no guide on how to use the product. For a commercial product, documentation is part of the product.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Documentation and API spec exposure only. No product code changes beyond enabling OpenAPI docs endpoint.

success_criteria: docs/manual/operator-manual.md covers all major operator workflows.
docs/manual/getting-started.md guides a new operator to first scan in 5 minutes.
README.md reflects the current product state and links to manual.
No internal governance language in user-facing docs.
A non-developer can follow the getting-started guide without asking questions.

acceptance_criteria: Manual exists and covers all workflows.

before_promotion: AegisPT security self-test (backlog-100) is completed and logged.
after_completion: Update CURRENT_STATE.md with user documentation as active.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
